documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Pradeep Metals Limited reported steady operational and financial progress for the financial year 2025-26, driven by new customer additions, cost optimization, and diversified product mix. Management highlighted strategic initiatives including the Board's approval of up to Rs. 250 Crores for a greenfield manufacturing facility in Butibori, Nagpur, to cater to global defense demand. The company also expanded machining capabilities, progressed on renewable energy projects, and maintained robust sustainability practices. Furthermore, overall revenues and profitability showed encouraging growth on both standalone and consolidated bases.

demand_outlook.claim: The total income of the WOS and SDS decreased due to reduced customer demand and lower sales prices.
demand_outlook.quote: The total income of WOS and SDS decreased in the current year due to reduction in Customer’s demand and reduction in sales price.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the total income of the wholly-owned subsidiary decreased due to a reduction in customer demand and sales price margin.
demand_outlook.quote: The total income of WOS decreased in the current year due to reduction in customer’s demand and sales price margin due to lower steel prices in comparison to the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Performance improved due to cost optimization measures and effective management control alongside other factors.
margins_costs.quote: The performance of the Company has improved compared to the previous year, driven by the addition of new customers, a diversified product mix, cost optimization measures, and effective management control.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax declined due to reduced sales prices, increased depreciation from new machinery and solar plant installations, and higher finance costs.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after Tax of the Company has declined due to (a) reduction in sales price; (b) increase in Depreciation because of addition / replacement of new machineries & installation of Solar Plant; and (c) increase in the finance cost.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated profitability of subsidiaries decreased due to lower sales prices, higher finance costs, and increased employee benefit costs.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated profitability of the Subsidiaries has decreased mainly due to (a) reduction in sales prices, (b) increase in the finance cost and (c) increase in employee benefit cost due to yearly increments in SDS.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors recommended a final dividend of 25% amounting to Rs. 2.50 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors have recommended a Final Dividend of 25% i.e., Rs. 2.50/- per Equity Share of Rs. 10/- each for the Financial Year ended 31st March , 2025 at the Board Meeting held on 22nd May, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: No amount was transferred to the General Reserve.
capital_allocation.quote: No amount has been transferred to the General Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The company applied for 2,24,167 equity shares worth Rs. 2,236.80 Lakhs of its wholly-owned US subsidiary in lieu of converting outstanding loans.
capital_allocation.quote: During the Financial Year under review, Company has applied for 2,24,167 Equity Shares for Rs. 2,236.80 Lakhs of Pradeep Metals Limited Inc., U.S.A., (PML Inc.) the Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: M/s. Shweta Gokarn & Co. was appointed as Secretarial Auditors for a term of five consecutive years from FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: M/s. Shweta Gokarn & Co., Practicing Company Secretaries (Firm Registration Number: S2012MH186500), as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for a term of five (5) consecutive years, to hold office from the conclusion of 42nd Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) till the conclusion of 47th AGM of the Company, to conduct secretarial audit of the Company from FY2025-26 to FY2029-30 at such remuneration as may be determined by the Board of Directors of the Company, based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
